verdict.line: You lose if Illaoi wins trades before level 6 and snowballs tentacle uptime; you win if you survive to Trinity Force and out-scale her with Fury of the Sands.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson) is a 4-second-cooldown dash-trade tool that also pulls nearby Tentacles into the fight, so every short trade she starts near a wall or jungle camp hits harder than it looks. Nasus has no way to punish the dash itself and must win by refusing those trades, stacking Q (Siphoning Strike) on minions, and letting W (Wither) plus Spirit Fire do the scaling work instead of trying to brawl her on her terms.

theirWindow.when: she lands E on you near a Tentacle
theirWindow.what: If the spirit is tethered near a wall-spawned Tentacle, do not stand and fight — the echo damage plus Tentacle swings plus her W dash-in can burst you before you can disengage, so walk the spirit away from the Tentacle immediately.

yourWindow.when: she has no Tentacles up and E is on cooldown (12-16s)
yourWindow.what: This is your trade window: step up, land Q on the minion wave for stacks and lifesteal, and only trade autos if she has to walk forward without a Tentacle backing her up.

powerCurve.note: Her W dash wins extended trades before your Q stacks matter
E-into-Tentacle combo threatens kill pressure, OP.GG confirms solo-kill edge
Your R (Fury of the Sands) check matches her all-in burst
Wither cooldown (11-13s) lets you kite her engages reliably
Trinity Force plus stacked Q damage outscales her flat tentacle damage

start.why: Taken in 67.6% of games at 49.1% win rate — the sustain and poke-reduction directly counters her W dash-ins and Tentacle chip damage while you farm Q stacks.

boots.why: Picked 32.8% of the time — her entire kit is physical (Tentacles, W, E echo, R), so the flat auto-attack reduction blunts every poke source she has.

core.why: First item in the 63.9%-win, 14.6%-pick path — the damage and speed spike is what finally lets you win trades instead of just surviving them.
Second item in the strongest measured path — armor plus attack speed slow directly blunts her Tentacle-assisted auto trades.
Common alternate third item (65.2% win in the Trinity-Frozen Heart-Thornmail order) — punishes her for landing W dashes on you.

situational.when: she is building AD and you need the healing amp to win extended sieges
she rushes lifesteal or heavy AD items and you need the grievous wounds earlier
you want Spirit Fire to proc a slow for easier stack-securing on retreating minions

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in 52.9% of games at 47.7% win rate — the sustain from the heal-on-hit proc offsets her W/E poke damage during the stretches where you're just trying to farm Q stacks safely.

summoners.why: The highest-pick combo (50% pick rate) — Ghost lets you close distance or disengage from her W dash without a flash-cooldown commitment, and Teleport resets you after short trades so you don't lose CS to her Tentacle poke.

playing.title: Farm Q, don't chase autos
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike (Q, 4-8s cooldown) is your entire scaling plan — prioritize landing it on minions over trading autos with Illaoi, since her Tentacle-backed trades are not worth matching blow for blow.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown
playing.detail: Test of Spirit is 12-16s on cooldown — once she uses it on you or a ward, you have a clean window to push a stack or two before she can threaten the spirit-echo combo again.

playing.title: Never fight near Tentacle walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing at you once her E or Vessels are active — reposition trades away from jungle walls and the lane's edge terrain.

playing.title: Use Wither to disengage, not initiate
playing.detail: W (Wither, 11-15s cooldown) slows her Movement and Attack Speed — save it for when she commits her W dash on you so you can walk away safely, rather than using it to start a fight you can't finish.

playing.title: Save Spirit Fire for shove timings
playing.detail: E (Spirit Fire, 12s cooldown) reduces armor on the zone — drop it on the wave when you want to shove fast for a Teleport-back reset, not just as poke.

playing.title: Hold R for her all-in, not for farming
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands (120s cooldown) is your answer to her all-in burst from level 6 on — don't burn it just to speed up stacking when she hasn't committed.

playing.title: Respect the early solo-kill risk
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read is to manage distance and avoid her skills while farming Q — at levels 1-5 her kill pressure is real, so play for even trades and stacks, not damage races.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning — tells, timings, and trade logic — is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Illaoi’s (E) while laning. Focus on farming with [Q] to gain stacks and heal, and always manage your distance to avoid Illaoi’s skills.
